facts.fact: Customs seized 10 Starlink modems at the Nkometou checkpoint on 12 December 2025 as unauthorised equipment.
Starlink is described as technically banned in Cameroon since April 2024, with systematic customs seizure ordered, and SpaceX suspended service for users in April 2024 after government warnings.

As of the article, ART had finalised a draft concession convention and specifications for Starlink Cameroun SARL, passed to the technical supervisory ministry for possible grant; no licence granted yet.
